Father in the Pendant!]]'' }} |} '''Ryuki''' (Japanese: '''リュウキ''' ''Ryūki'') is a [[non-player character]] in the [[Generation VII]] {{pkmn|games}}. He is a rock guitarist and a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Dragon}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In the core series games== Ryuki is a rock musician who has traveled to [[Alola]] from another [[region]] beyond the sea in order to spread his fame. He is one of the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who can [[Pokémon League (Alola)/Title Defense|challenge]] the {{player}} for the title of [[Pokémon Champion]] in {{al|Pokémon League}} rematches in [[Pokémon Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon]], [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon]]. In Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, Ryuki also sometimes appears at the [[Kantonian Gym]] in [[Malie City]], where he can be battled, although defeating him is not necessary to complete the Kantonian Gym challenge. After being defeated for the first time, he gives the player a [[Dragon Scale]]. He also promises to become a {{type|Dragon}} [[Gym Leader]] once real [[Gym]]s start appearing in Alola. ===Pokémon=== Ryuki's Pokémon are kept in [[Ultra Ball]]s. ====Pokémon Sun and Moon==== {{Party {{pkmn|Sun and Moon|Sun, Moon}}, {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Ryuki/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Ryuki anime.png|thumb|250px|Ryuki in {{aniseries|SM}}]] Ryuki appeared in ''[[SM118|Aiming for the Top Floor!]]'' as the leader of the [[Kantonian Gym]]. He first had a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{an|Kiawe}}, easily defeating his {{TP|Kiawe|Marowak}} when it became distracted by Ryuki's music. Next, he battled {{Ash}}, but when {{AP|Rowlet}} was losing to Ryuki's {{p|Zweilous}}, {{AP|Meltan}} became infuriated and ate some of the decorations on Ryuki's suit in retaliation. Ryuki then changed the match into a [[Double Battle]], with Ash using Rowlet and Meltan against Ryuki's {{p|Druddigon}} and Zweilous. Thanks to Rowlet learning {{m|Brave Bird}}, Ash was able to win the match. Ryuki then gave him a [[Badge]] bearing a picture of his own face as a proof of his victory. ===Character=== Ryuki considers himself a star, and his stage persona tends to take over the battlefield. He tends to shout into his microphone to ensure that he gets his way. He insists on being called "Leader", as he feels anything less disregards his individuality and undermines his authority. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Ryuki's known [[Pokémon]] in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ryuki |pkmn=Zweilous |type1=Dark |type2=Dragon |img=Ryuki Zweilous.png |epnum=SM118 |epname=Aiming for the Top Floor! |vajp= |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Zweilous}} is Ryuki's first known Pokémon. Zweilous was first used to battle [[Kiawe's Marowak]], easily defeating it when it got distracted by his music. Zweilous then battled [[Ash's Rowlet]]. It was soon joined by his {{p|Druddigon}} in a [[Double Battle]] against Rowlet and {{AP|Meltan}}. Both {{t|Dragon}} Pokémon were soon defeated. Zweilous's heads have a tendency to fight each other, though Ryuki's music keeps them in check. Zweilous's known moves are {{m|Dark Pulse}}, {{m|Dragon Rush}}, and {{m|Bite}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ryuki |pkmn=Druddigon |type1=Dragon |img=Ryuki Druddigon.png |epnum=SM118 |epname=Aiming for the Top Floor! |vajp=Toru Sakurai |vaen= |desc={{p|Druddigon}} is Ryuki's second known Pokémon. Druddigon teamed up with Zweilous to battle [[Ash's Rowlet]] and {{AP|Meltan}}, but was soon defeated. Druddigon's only known move is {{m|Dragon Claw}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{dragon color light}}|bordercolor={{dragon color dark}} |ja=古島清孝 ''[[Kiyotaka Furushima]]'' |en=[[List of English voice actors|Adam Ezegelian]] |pl=Mateusz Weber |pt_br=Rodrigo Antas |es_la=Geezuz González |es_eu=Juan Antonio Soler}} ==In the manga== [[File:Ryuki Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Ryuki in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Ryuki debuted in ''[[PASM32|Shock!! Father in the Pendant!]]''. He considers himself a battling superstar, so he traveled to [[Alola]] in hopes of fighting the powerful [[Ultra Beast]]s. He was hired by [[Faba]], who agreed to help Ryuki in exchange for his services. Ryuki was sent to [[Mount Lanakila]], where he found {{adv|Moon}} lying unconscious in the snow after she returned to Alola via an [[Ultra Wormhole]]. He picked the girl up and took her to [[Aether Paradise]], where Faba had her locked in a cell. Moon was later freed by [[Gladion]], who teamed up with her to stop Faba. Cornered, Faba tricked Ryuki into helping him by revealing [[Gladion's Silvally]] was created to defeat the Ultra Beasts. This subsequently prompted Ryuki to battle Gladion and Moon in order to defend his place in the spotlight. After losing his first Pokémon, Ryuki sent out two more, only for Gladion to stop him and call off the battle, revealing Faba was using it as a distraction so he could flee Aether Paradise. After learning that others were fighting the Ultra Beasts elsewhere in Alola, Ryuki ran off to join them. Months later, Gladion and Dulse set off to rescue Faba, who had been dragged into [[Ultra Space]] by several {{p|Nihilego}}. Ryuki chose to accompany them, much to Gladion's annoyance. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ryuki |pkmn=Turtonator |type1=Fire |type2=Dragon |img=Ryuki Turtonator Adventures.png |epnum=PASM34 |epname=Destroy!!
